name: portal-manutencao
description: Portal de Manutenção de Condomínio | Full-Stack

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose --profile monolith up --build
scripts.docker:mysql: docker compose exec mysql mysql -uroot -proot123 portal_manutencao
